subject: MedNova onboarding — MSA/Order Form redlines, SCCs mapping and DPA alignment
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@mednova.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@mednova.com
Date: 2028-03-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: Initial redlines for MSA + DPA — MedNova onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached are MedNova's initial redlines for the MSA, Order Form and a first-pass DPA. High level items to call out:
- We propose modifying the processor role language in Section 3 to reflect our platform acts as a co-processor for model training data (see DPA §2.1).
- We'd like to capture EU SCCs acceptance but include a short transfer-impact addendum for third-country subprocessors.
- Request confirmation on KMS integration — will Redwood support customer-provided keys for the new account?

Target timeline on our side is signature by March 28 so we can kick off pilot in April. Can you confirm legal/ops availability for a 30-minute redline call next week?

Attachment: MedNova_Redlines_MSA_DPA_v1.docx (docx)

Best,
Alex Torres
Head of Procurement, MedNova, Inc.
alex.torres@mednova.com
+44 20 5555 1212
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@mednova.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-08T11:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial redlines for MSA + DPA — MedNova onboarding

Alex — thanks for sending this through. I pulled Ben (contracts) and Laura (legal ops) into the thread. Quick reactions and asks so we come prepared to the call:

1) Roles & SCCs: we can work with the standard EU SCCs but need to map controller/processor roles in a short table (who is controller for customer data vs telemetry). Can your legal team confirm the expected mapping?
2) Subprocessors: please share your canonical subprocessor list or confirm you accept Redwood's standard list plus the option to add new infra subprocessors with notice.
3) KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; for Hosted accounts we need a KMS integration plan. Which deployment will MedNova use for pilot?
4) Transfer-impact addendum: if MedNova needs a bespoke transfer addendum (e.g., data localization carveouts), flag it now so we can route to product/infra.

I've attached our annotated order form + a lightweight redline of the DPA so we can compare side-by-side in the call. Proposed times: Tue 14th 09:00-09:30 or Wed 15th 14:00-14:30 (BST).

Attachment: RNW_OrderForm_DPA_Redlines_IRENE.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I can host the call and run the sync.

Irene Choi
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@mednova.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@mednova.com>, procurement@mednova.com
Date: 2028-03-09T07:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial redlines for MSA + DPA — MedNova onboarding

Thanks Irene. We can do Tue 14th 09:00 BST — that works for our legal and procurement leads. A few clarifications ahead of the call:
- We will be controller for customer-submitted PHI/PII; MedNova expects Redwood to be processor for inference and ephemeral logs. We'll bring a brief mapping doc.
- Subprocessor list: attaching our current hosting/subprocessor list (network infra, telemetry, analytics). We prefer that changes to infra subprocessors be handled via 30-day notice rather than prior approval.
- KMS: pilot will be Hosted API initially; we do not expect customer-managed KMS for the pilot but would like the option in Prod.

Attaching: MedNova_SCCs_Position.pdf (pdf)

Alex

Alex / Clara — I'm Ben in Contracts. Short summary from our side after a first pass of the redlines:

- Processor/Controller: We can accept the controller/processor split you propose but need precise language around inferred telemetry (we propose adding a small carveout where telemetry is treated as operational metadata and processed under our processor obligations).
- SCCs: Redwood will accept the EU SCC modules but want a clean sign-off that the "Special Terms — International Transfers" will be resolved before production rollout. If you insist on a transfer-impact addendum, please flag which territories trigger it.
- Liability/Cap: we are running this through commercial but the current MedNova proposal increases cap on indirect damages — we will propose counter-language at the call.

I've attached a document with inline comments and a redline of the DPA (RNW_Ben_InlineComments_DPA.docx). For Ops: can you confirm the hosting region(s) — EU-only or EU+US? That will affect SCC applicability.

HubSpot deal: HS-23456 (for Redwood sales ops)

Attachment: RNW_Ben_InlineComments_DPA.docx (docx)

Ben / team,

Appreciate the quick read-through. A few points from MedNova Legal:
- We're generally comfortable with the telemetry carveout as described, please provide a one-paragraph definition (what fields are considered telemetry vs customer data).
- For SCCs, MedNova prefers to sign the latest EU SCCs with Annex configurations. We can accept a 30-day notice model for infra subprocessors but need the list in a shared tracker and a right to review any new processors affecting EU transfers.
- Transfer-impact addendum: we have one internal market (Norway) that may require a short addendum; I'll attach our Annex and proposed language.

Attachment: MedNova_DPA_Annex_Clara_v2.docx (docx)

Let's confirm the call agenda tomorrow: 1) Roles mapping table; 2) Subprocessor list & notice process; 3) SCCs + transfer language; 4) Execution path + timeline.

Best,
